posts.text:
We are pleased to invite you and your colleagues to participate in the DesignTech 2026 – International Conference on Design and Technology, which will take place on May 6-7th, 2026 at the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology, Haifa.

This interdisciplinary conference provides a platform for researchers and practitioners to present their latest work in the evolving field of design and technology. We welcome abstract submissions (300–500 words) that reflect innovative research and emerging design theory.

Submission Deadline: March 31 2026
Notification of Acceptance: April 16, 2026
Submit to: designtech2026@technion.ac.il

about.bio: Industrial Designer and Researcher with over a decade of hands-on experience in product development, advanced manufacturing, and cross-disciplinary research. I merge traditional craft with AI and computational design to solve complex challenges. Leveraging expertise in generative modeling and software development, I build data-driven physical products, ranging from parametric medical prosthetics to bespoke musical instruments. Adept at guiding projects from rapid prototyping to finished products, integrating electronics and mechanical engineering for startups and advanced research labs.

experience.title: Researcher
experience.text: Research in algorithms and AI, psychoacoustics, computational acoustics, generative design, marine biology and marine environments, artificial coral reef rehabilitation, 3D printing, CNC, plastic recycling and research-based design.

experience.title: Lab Manager & Teaching Assistant
experience.text: Ran daily lab operations, budgets, collaborations and conferences; taught design and AI courses and maintained the 3D printers and CNC machines.

experience.title: Co-founder & Head of Product
experience.text: Startup preventing weapon misuse and theft. Led development across mechanics, electronics, software and design, delivering several functional proofs of concept.

experience.title: Mechanical Engineer & CAD for Manufacturing
experience.text: Conceptualized and developed products for manufacturing, with detailed work plans for smooth production.

experience.title: Industrial & Mechanical Designer
experience.text: Mechanical, medical-equipment and graphic design; solved customer problems with UX & UI, CAD and procedural modeling.

experience.title: Workshop Supervisor
experience.text: Ran the industrial design workshops: wood, machining, plastics and composites. CNC, laser, 3D printing and manual machines.

experience.title: Prosthesis Designer
experience.text: Product designer on a parametric prosthesis project, combining programming and parametric design.

experience.title: Industrial Designer
experience.text: Designed and built functional products; industrial design services, material spraying, mechanical engineering, UX & UI.
